turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyTail:
ers have a standard processing time of 3 to 5 business days before they ship, regardless of the shipping method selected (excluding Domestic Overnight orders placed before 10:30 AM PST, which process same-day).
Once your order is fulfilled, you'll receive a shipping confirmation email with your tracking number! Please allow up to 72 hours after receiving the number for tracking updates to appear.
If you'd like me to check the status of your order, just share your order number and email address!

For domestic orders within the contiguous US:
menu
• Economy Domestic Shipping: 7 to 10 business days

For international orders, delivery times vary based on the country and chosen courier option at checkout. If you'd like me to look up your specific order details, feel free to share your order number and email address!

turns.replyTail:
you shop
menu
Is there any way to speed it up if I need it sooner?
Once an order is placed, we aren't able to edit it or upgrade the shipping method on it.
However, contiguous US orders without priority shipping can be canceled up to 2 hours after being placed directly from your Order Confirmation page (accessible via your confirmation email). You could then place a new order selecting an expedited shipping option like Domestic Overnight at checkout!
Is there anything else I can help you with?

Can I reroute the package to a different address?
Once an order has been shipped, it is not possible to re-route the package or update the delivery address.
If your package is returned to our warehouse due to an incorrect address, you will have 7 days to request a re-shipment (note that re-shipment shipping costs are the customer's responsibility).
